notes.title: 0.8.0 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello all players, as we have put most of our efforts on the up coming non-VR version of TAG WAR. This week comes a minor update. 

1. A random naming system which make the BOT in game more interesting.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/8fb8d7cbe8f4fef90b713fc3789cc1116b7d8840.jpg[/img]

2. BOTs are included in the award system now.

3. Other minor updates

Thanks for all the support and remember the non-VR version is coming next week!!

2. BOTs are included in the award system now.

notes.title: 0.7.0 update patch note
notes.content:
Here's the 0.7.0 update for TAG WAR.

1. Preset skin for those who is not good at painting.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/e52a6769957e8603c6eec93303eaa8c7f1573dff.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/b4284a78b38cd11923923080fc991c04cbd894cb.png[/img]

2. A new award system showing the MVP of each match. And also a hidden prize at the flash sale.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/0dcefbc64bbe6365e064b9d7275661b13bf65b08.png[/img]

3. A new control method allow you to rotate with your controller

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/30677066d603fa5ac8d2364285d5254f631fee50.jpg[/img]

4. More friendly info for each setting. Some video showing the effect of each setting.

5. Countless little bugs fixed 

Thank you for all the support. We are nearly there. 1.0.0 will coming soon!!

tags.feature: 1. Preset skin for those who is not good at painting.
2. A new award system showing the MVP of each match. And also a hidden prize at the flash sale.
3. A new control method allow you to rotate with your controller
4. More friendly info for each setting. Some video showing the effect of each setting.

notes.title: 0.6.0 update patch note
notes.content:
Here comes the version 0.6.0 update. 
Adding these new feature

First, in-game voice chat 
Allow you to talk to your teammate and make a tactical plan.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/5d413488b9be9d6ddeb9307b5f3f263ec4c6d50d.png[/img]

Second, a lovely intro animation
No spoiler, you have to check it yourself.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/77d4d0f01d2071458a86f28625c7cac393fdfd6d.jpg[/img]

Third, we have greatly improve the latency of getting a item after scanning.
Also, there's some minor bug fixed.

notes.title: 0.5.1 update patch note
notes.content:
Version 0.5.1 launching today. 
Adding offline mode and better optimization. 

Offline Mode
- Allow you to play without Internet or under bad Internet status.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/eb12a76f396c0c50d14090c845b1f7a0562a5c92.jpg[/img]

Optimization
- Reducing the size of TAG WAR for nearly 1GB.
- Improving the performance for higher frame rates.

- Allow you to play without Internet or under bad Internet status.

notes.title: Update 0.5.0 patch note
notes.content:
Here’s the 0.5.0 update!! Adding a lot interesting stuff and useful feature.

First, after a lot gamers complaining it’s difficult to throw item with Oculus touch.
We decided to add an new throwing mode allow you to easily shoot an item.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/f669b9dd9264850f3d677baf0a61615d371f12f3.png[/img]

We also add some information to make new player understand TAG WAR quickly.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/5e72a61321da315067271d5847e4b0cbb91b35b3.png[/img]

And here’s the new items!! Soap and plastic chicken.
Throw the soap to create a slippy trap and make anyone who touch it hard to control.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/1c5f6c1af8b2dd957bf846b62f802f200920ba23.jpg[/img]

And the plastic chicken will make you funny, big and invincible!!
You have to try it right now!!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/4dc8ee362920dac959ae036d2bb6f0c018e8176c.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/e5ea24e80eb77a6ec1b26b8810aa7a4af5df8bc3.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: We decided to add an new throwing mode allow you to easily shoot an item.
We also add some information to make new player understand TAG WAR quickly.
And here’s the new items!! Soap and plastic chicken.

notes.title: Update 0.4.0 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players,
We are glad to announce that update 0.4.0 is online now.

Adding these new features
- Option for changing server region

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 for new content
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players,
We are glad to announce that update 0.3.0 is online now.
For past few updates we focus on bugs fix and some system features.
And finally there will be new content with follow updates.

Starting with new item [b]Squid[/b] !!
Use squid to spray ink and block your enemy view.
But be careful you might get some ink on your face too.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/42111edaa31b5aac15d5b28730cf2645c8fb9ebd.jpg[/img]


Also after some player feedback. We decide to re-design the main menu.
For a more friendly user experience.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742516/4d44f1d63b96e04c7eded9aa5b2f9db281b97e70.jpg[/img]


The achievement system is also available now. Please check it.
  
Thank again for all the players who have supported us so far!!

Hello players thanks for your support.
We are excited to release update 0.2.1 today adding some features players have asked about.
Please update your game through Steam before launching the game.
 
Version 0.2.1 patch note
[New Feature]
- Additional options for reducing VR sickness
- Option to enable left/right movement
- Option to disable in-game UI
- Improved ending scene
- Improved BOT behavior 
[Bug Fixed]
- Problems of team UI in lobby
- Bugs in tutorial scene
- Other minor bugs

Here’s the detail of version 0.2.0 patch note
[New Feature]
 - Intro logo animation
 - Notes for health and safety
 - UI feedback in main menu
 - Steam profile picture in lobby
 - Improvements in AI bot
 - Improvements in customization
[Bug Fixed]
 - Stuck in ending scene under certain circumstances
 - Stuck in tutorial scene under certain circumstances

 - Problems of team UI in lobby
